title: Israel's Defense Ministry Reports 1,318 Security Personnel Killed Since October 7
detail: Israel's Defense Ministry released official cumulative casualty figures reporting that 1,318 security personnel have been killed since the October 7, 2023 Hamas attack. This represents the official Israeli government accounting of military and security losses across more than three years of conflict.

title: Israeli Strike on Civilian Vehicle in Central Gaza Kills One, Wounds 11; Crossings Closed on Oct 7 Anniversary
detail: An Israeli strike on a civilian vehicle in central Gaza (Deir al-Balah area) on Sunday morning killed one Palestinian and wounded at least 11 others, per local health officials. The strike followed Saturday's Gaza City apartment strike that killed five, four of them women. Gaza's Health Ministry put the ceasefire-period toll at about 1,445-1,446 killed and over 5,060 wounded. Israel's Defense Minister ordered all crossings into Gaza and the West Bank closed for the anniversary of the October 7, 2023 attack.
